name: Greek Turkey Spinach & Feta Meatball Bake
why: Distinct Greek/Mediterranean oven bake (no orzo/rice/potato base) adding cuisine variety to an American-skewed catalog; PUBLISHED nutrition clears the band at 404 cal / 34 g protein / 13 g carb per serving (4-serving basis). High protein relative to calories, structurally low-carb, and batch-scalable: form meatballs, bake in a 9x13 pan; multiply x3.5 for 14 servings. Not a duplicate of the pool's turkey meatloaf, enchilada, zucchini-noodle, cauliflower-mushroom or broccoli-cheddar bakes, nor of catalog greek-turkey-meatballs-with-lemon-orzo (orzo, high-carb) or greek-turkey-youvarlakia (soup).
confidence: high on numbers (read from page); note calories at 404 sit near the 400 floor, so our label-DB compute could drift just under - the feta and egg fat give some cushion
